admission.justification: Preparing the scaffold before any seat exists is what lets a cold install start Bootstrap at all; the two cold-path cases name the scaffold gate and the host stage that follows it.

applicability: A Bootstrap role start on a host the MCP authority can run, when the coordination root, the memory root, or the runtime scaffold inside it is absent.
conditions: The runtime scaffold comes from the package-owned runtime assets, not from an installed harness skill folder.
A missing scaffold is created through the runtime owner before dispatch, and a missing memory root stays an expected setup state rather than a launch blocker.
A runtime block that is absent is created once; a configured host that cannot be loaded back, does not answer or owes a restart is refused by its own stage name instead of being treated as cold.
exclusions: A root configuration that is misconfigured rather than absent.
An installed skills directory as a precondition of launching.

evidence: a2/native-review.md N1; final-a3/source-witnesses.md; the new scaffold test manufactures SCAFFOLD_ENTRIES instead of using the installer.

statement: A cold Bootstrap launch prepares the retained runtime scaffold without requiring an installed skills directory.
